title: a gate returns an error (transient GPU error inside Gate 2)
scenario: Concept request for `Ladieswear || Sweater || Knitwear || Beige || Melange`, attempt 1 of 3. ip_adapter_scale 0.35, seed 42. Briefed changes: ['a high funnel neck collar', 'dark brown contrast rib cuffs and hem']. This is the FIRST scoring call for this image.

gate2.error: SmolVLM: CUDA out of memory while loading the judge (tried to allocate 1.2 GiB)

changes: dark brown contrast rib cuffs and hem

rubric.good_decision: INCONCLUSIVE: retry the SCORING call once (transient), do not regenerate, do not REJECT; if it fails again escalate.
rubric.equivalent: Retry scoring once, then escalate; or escalate at once naming the error.
rubric.worse: REJECT or a new generation (nothing failed), or treating the error as a pass.
rubric.better_if: Identifies the error as transient/resource and suggests the scoring retry happen after the GPU is free.
